race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 431 miles: 80–100g carbs/hour from mile 1 — don’t wait until you’re hungry. Practice your exact race-day nutrition in every long training ride. Carry backup calories. 431 miles burns 8,000–12,000+ calories — you cannot replace them all, but you must try.
race_overlay.altitude: Tour of Nilgiris (TFN) includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Tour of Nilgiris (TFN) rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountain passes to build confidence.
